# extractr

The goal of the `extractr` R library is to provide easy to use
extraction and summarization functions in R for common datasets (ERDDAP,
Google Earth Engine, DataOne, etc).

For an example on how to use the functions, please see [Get
started](https://marinebon.github.io/extractr/articles/extractr.md).

## Roadmap

ERDDAP:

  Basic extraction from polygon for ERDDAP datasets:
[`get_ed_grds()`](https://marinebon.github.io/extractr/reference/get_ed_grds.md)

  Utility functions for ERDDAP metadata:
[`ed_dims()`](https://marinebon.github.io/extractr/reference/ed_dims.md),
[`ed_dim()`](https://marinebon.github.io/extractr/reference/ed_dim.md),

  Improve raster generation for non-rectilinear grids:
[\#3](https://github.com/marinebon/extractr/issues/3)

Google Earth Engine (GEE):

  Basic extraction from polygon for GEE datasets:
[\#4](https://github.com/marinebon/extractr/issues/3)

# Package index

## All functions

- [`bbox_ply()`](https://marinebon.github.io/extractr/reference/bbox_ply.md)
  : Create polygon from bounding box
- [`check_url()`](https://marinebon.github.io/extractr/reference/check_url.md)
  : Check if a URL is online
- [`ed_dim()`](https://marinebon.github.io/extractr/reference/ed_dim.md)
  : Get dimension values from ERDDAP dataset
- [`ed_dims()`](https://marinebon.github.io/extractr/reference/ed_dims.md)
  : Get dimensions from ERDDAP dataset
- [`ed_extract()`](https://marinebon.github.io/extractr/reference/ed_extract.md)
  : ERDDAP Extract
- [`ed_info()`](https://marinebon.github.io/extractr/reference/ed_info.md)
  : Get ERDDAP dataset information
- [`ed_vars()`](https://marinebon.github.io/extractr/reference/ed_vars.md)
  : Get variables from ERDDAP dataset
- [`get_ed_grds()`](https://marinebon.github.io/extractr/reference/get_ed_grds.md)
  : Get Seascape grids within polygon for date range
- [`get_url_ply()`](https://marinebon.github.io/extractr/reference/get_url_ply.md)
  : Get polygon from link or NOAA Sanctuary code
- [`grds_to_ts()`](https://marinebon.github.io/extractr/reference/grds_to_ts.md)
  : Summarize grids with a continuous variable into a time series table
- [`grds_to_ts_cat()`](https://marinebon.github.io/extractr/reference/grds_to_ts_cat.md)
  : Summarize categorical grids into time series table
- [`plot_ts()`](https://marinebon.github.io/extractr/reference/plot_ts.md)
  : Plot time series
